title: The Peter Weyland Files: Quiet Eye, Elizabeth Shaw
original_title: The Peter Weyland Files: Quiet Eye, Elizabeth Shaw
overview: Confident that she knows where to search for answers regarding humankind's existential questions, the ambitious idealist and respected archaeologist, Doctor Elizabeth Shaw, contacts the founder of Weyland Corporation, Sir Peter Weyland, through a video call. As she introduces herself and explains her theory, Dr Shaw kindly requests a meeting in person so that they can discuss her extraordinary findings. Will Dr Shaw take part in the USCSS Prometheus (2012) expedition to locate the mysterious Engineers? —Nick Riganas
